# netbox_contacts (Data Source)

Retrieves all contacts from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contacts" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "contacts_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_contacts.example.contacts[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `contacts` (Attributes List) The contacts found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--contacts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address of the contacts.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the contacts.
- `created` (String) When the contacts was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the contacts, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the contacts.
- `email` (String) The email of the contacts.
- `groups` (List of Number) The IDs of the groups of the contacts.
- `id` (Number) The id of the contacts.
- `last_updated` (String) When the contacts was last changed.
- `link` (String) The link of the contacts.
- `name` (String) The name of the contacts.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the contacts.
- `phone` (String) The phone of the contacts.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `title` (String) The title of the contacts.
